format: C or C++ header (judging by file extension and content)
description: Header file defining internal ASN.1 object structures and functions for 'OtherName' and 'OtherString' types in ASN.1 encoding, used in cryptographic or certificate handling contexts.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherNameCreateChildAttr
methods.description: Creates attribute for a child object of ASN.1 OtherName.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherNameGetChildName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a child object of ASN.1 OtherName based on index.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherNameCreateChildObject
methods.description: Creates a child object within ASN.1 OtherName structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherStringCreateSelection
methods.description: Creates a selection choice within ASN.1 OtherString, e.g., KerberosName.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherStringCreateSelectionAttr
methods.description: Creates attribute for a selection choice within ASN.1 OtherString.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherStringGetSelectionName
methods.description: Gets the name of the selection type within ASN.1 OtherString.

methods.name: AnscAsn1OtherStringGetChoiceTagValue
methods.description: Retrieves the tag value associated with the choice type in ASN.1 OtherString.
